CustomField.label: Total Donations
CustomField.description: The running total of all donations linked to this event via the Opportunity object. Maintained by a Record-Triggered Flow on Opportunity (After Save) in Epic 4 — NOT a Roll-Up Summary Field, as the Opportunity→Event__c relationship is a Lookup, not a Master-Detail.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The total donations raised for this event. This value is updated automatically — do not edit manually.
